title: These Broken Stars
author: Amie Kaufman
summary: When a luxury starliner is pulled out of hyperspace and wrecked, a wealthy heiress and a young war hero are the only survivors on an eerie, unfamiliar planet and must trek to safety together.
readIf: you like teen science fiction with a slow-building romance and a survival story.
skipIf: you want hard science fiction with rigorous technical detail.
